maria: quick check — saw a spike of 429s across java/node SDKs when our token rotated earlier. are folks treating 401/403 always as hard-fail or is there a grace -> soft-retry pattern we recommend?
chris: short answer: treat 401/403 from auth refresh as a token race; if we return a token_grace header the client should refresh and retry quickly. 429 -> honor Retry-After if present otherwise expo+jitter. streams are special (prefer resume token).
sasha: to add — backend now sends X-Token-Grace: 30 when rotation happens. pattern: if client gets 401 + X-Token-Grace, trigger refresh and retry once immediately (with new token) before doing expo. avoids long backoffs for transient rotation.
jonah: what's the concrete retry policy we should document in SDKs? want numbers so doc PR can be merged.
maria: proposal: 429 -> if Retry-After header: wait that many seconds. else: exponential backoff with full jitter, base=250ms, cap=5s, max_attempts=6. 5xx -> expo with base=500ms, cap=20s, max_attempts=5. 401/403 + X-Token-Grace -> refresh token and retry once immediately (no attempt increment).
chris: code example for full jitter backoff (pseudo):
```
fn backoff(attempt) {
  base = 250; // ms
  max = 5000; // ms
  sleep = min(max, base * 2^attempt)
  jitter = rand(0, sleep)
  return jitter
}
```
use that for 429/5xx when Retry-After missing.
sasha: streaming nuance: when a stream disconnects mid-response, prefer resume-token header flow. server returns X-Resume-Token + X-Resume-Window (secs). client should reconnect and send Resume-Token within that window. If resume token expired, fall back to idempotency key to re-run the request (but can cost extra tokens).
jonah: language quirks: Java HttpClient tends to surface socket resets as 499/408 variants depending on proxy. our SDK should normalize network errors to retriable 5xx-like logic and attempt resume (if stream) or expo retry (if unary). Node gotchas: don't double-retry on auth refresh; refresh should be synchronized (single inflight refresh).
maria: important: for non-idempotent ops (uploads, side-effecting calls) require client-provided Idempotency-Key header. SDKs should auto-generate a UUID for CLI/server-side calls but expose override for users. docs PR will include examples for curl/java/node/python.
chris: TL;DR for the PR: 1) honor Retry-After, 2) use token_grace to short-circuit auth races, 3) full-jitter expo defaults above, 4) resume-token for streams, 5) require Idempotency-Key for side-effecting endpoints.
